recommendations.description: Increase test coverage for TodoApp component, particularly for edge cases like empty input validation and non-existent todo deletion. Current coverage is 65% but should target 85%+.
Add mobile responsiveness to CSS. The app lacks media queries for smaller viewports, which is critical for user experience on mobile devices.
Implement TypeScript interfaces for all component props in TodoApp. Missing prop-type validation reduces type safety and can lead to runtime errors.
Optimize React component rendering by implementing useCallback for event handlers and React.memo for child components. This will prevent unnecessary re-renders and improve performance.
Extract filtering logic into a separate utility function. This improves testability, reusability, and separates concerns between UI and business logic.
Consider migrating to CSS-in-JS (Styled Components/Emotion) or CSS Modules for better component scoping and reduced global namespace pollution.
Add JSDoc comments to utility functions in todoHelpers.ts for better code discoverability and IDE support.
Standardize spacing units (mix of px and em) and implement CSS custom properties for consistent theming across the application.
